import json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
root=Path('.')
doc=json.loads((root/'outputs/v0/design_document.json').read_text())
changes=json.loads((root/'outputs/v0/change_set.json').read_text())
state=json.loads((root/'outputs/project-state.json').read_text())
expected=['xhs','instagram','story','wechat','meta','web','event-wall']
checks={}
checks['channel_ids']=[c['id'] for c in doc['channels']]
checks['channel_count']=len(doc['channels'])
checks['all_channels_exact']=checks['channel_ids']==expected
checks['all_four_roles_reserved']=all(set(c['layout']) >= {'title','eventInfo','sculpture','registrationUrl'} for c in doc['channels'])
checks['url_slots_count']=sum('registrationUrl' in c['layout'] for c in doc['channels'])
lock={x['id']:x for x in doc['contentLocks']}
checks['known_lock_values']={k:lock[k]['value'] for k in ['lock-title','lock-date','lock-location']}
checks['url_blocker_recorded']=lock['lock-registration-url']['status']=='blocked_missing_input' and lock['lock-registration-url']['value'] is None
checks['master_mutation_false']=changes['approvedMasterMutation'] is False
checks['planned_change_channels']=[c['channelId'] for c in changes['channelChanges']]
checks['no_changes_applied']=all(c['status']=='planned_not_applied' for c in changes['channelChanges'])
im=Image.open(root/'outputs/v0/preview.png').convert('RGB')
checks['preview_dimensions']=list(im.size)
colors=im.resize((256,180)).getcolors(256*180)
checks['preview_unique_colors']=len(colors or [])
checks['preview_not_blank']=len(colors or [])>100
for rel in ['inputs/01-approved_master.png','outputs/v0/preview.png','outputs/v0/design_document.json','outputs/v0/change_set.json']:
    checks.setdefault('sha256',{})[rel]=hashlib.sha256((root/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
print(json.dumps(checks,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
PY
